<?php
class Base143A { public $value = 4; public function __construct($n) { echo 'B', $this->value, '|'; $this->value += $n; } public function read() { return $this->value; } }
$o = new class(3) extends Base143A {};
echo $o->read(), '|', ($o instanceof Base143A ? 'yes' : 'no');

<?php
class Base143B { public $value = 5; public function __construct($n) { echo 'B', $this->value, '|'; $this->value += $n; } public function read() { return $this->value; } }
$o = new class(3) extends Base143B { public function __construct($n) { echo 'C', $this->value, '|'; parent::__construct($n); echo 'D', $this->value, '|'; } };
echo $o->read();

<?php
class Base143C { public $value = 8; public function who() { return static::class; } public function base() { return self::class; } }
function make143() { return new class extends Base143C {}; }
$a = make143(); $b = make143();
echo ($a !== $b ? 'fresh|' : 'bad|'), ($a::class === $b::class ? 'same|' : 'bad|'), ($a->who() === $a::class ? 'called|' : 'bad|'), $a->base(), '|', $a->value;

<?php
class Base143D { private $value = 9; public function parentValue() { return $this->value; } }
$o = new class extends Base143D { public $value = 2; public function childValue() { return $this->value; } };
echo $o->parentValue(), '|', $o->childValue(), '|', $o->value;

<?php
$o = new class(3) { public $value = 0; public function __construct($n) { $this->value = $n; } }; echo $o->value;

<?php
class Base143 {
    public $seed = 5;
    public function __construct(int $step) {
        echo 'B', $step, '|';
        $this->seed += $step;
    }
    public function label() { return static::class; }
}
function make143() {
    global $input143;
    return new class($input143) extends Base143 {
        public function __construct(int $step) {
            echo 'A', $this->seed, '|';
            parent::__construct($step);
            echo 'C', $this->seed, '|';
        }
    };
}
$input143 = 3; $first = make143();
$input143 = 4; $second = make143();
echo $first !== $second ? 'different|' : 'same-object|';
echo $first::class === $second::class ? 'same-class|' : 'different-class|';
echo $first->label() === $first::class ? 'called|' : 'wrong-called|';
echo $first->seed, '/', $second->seed;

echo '|', $first::class;
